title: Pixel Hop
controls: Arrow keys or A / D: run (hold Shift to run faster)
Space, Up or W: jump (hold for higher)
Stomp enemies from above, grab the coins, reach the flag: three levels, the last is The Edge
Together: open it at the same time as others and you are one team. Coins are shared, you can stand on a teammate's head, and a level clears when everyone reaches the flag
R: restart · M: mute · Esc: back to chat
